Wed28 Oct

Food & hidden canals

  1. 10:30–13:00
    🍕 Savour Venice street food tour To book Airbnb ↗Starts at Campo San Bartolomio near Rialto. Cicchetti (Venetian tapas), a bakery sweet and gelato. Probably counts as lunch!
  2. Afternoon
    🚶 Wander DorsoduroThe arty side of Venice: little bridges, the Zattere waterfront, Campo Santa Margherita.
  3. 15:00–16:45
    🛶 “Unveil the unseen Venice” small boat To book Airbnb ↗Through the hidden back canals. Meets at Campo San Trovaso, near the Zattere stop.
  4. After
    🏠 Back to CastelloWalk or vaporetto. Tap a contactless card, €9.50 a ride.
🍽 TonightDa Bubi · 18:45Menu ↓
Thu29 Oct

Islands: Burano & Murano

  1. 08:20
    🚶 Leave the flat~10 min walk to Fondamente Nove, pier A. First tap of the boat passes.

    🚤 Line 12 to BuranoArrives 09:23.

    🏺 Museo del Vetro (glass museum)Open till 18:00, last entry 17:00. Family rate: 3 × €7.50. Sunset is 17:02.

Fri30 Oct

Quiet Venice + Biennale, then the night boat

  1. 09:35
    🚶 Walk to San Zaccaria
  2. 09:49
    🚤 Line 2 → San Giorgio (09:52)The basilica: Palladio’s bright white interior and Tintoretto’s Last Supper. Free. (Bell tower closed for maintenance.)
  3. 10:52
    🚤 Line 2 → Zitelle, GiudeccaSlow walk along the waterfront. Redentore church is free, open from 10:30.
  4. 12:30
    🍝 Lunch on GiudeccaTrattoria Altanella, family-run since 1938 (booking advised, +39 041 5227780), or La Palanca right on the water (walk in).
  5. 13:51
    🚤 Line 4.1, Palanca → Giardini (14:07)
  6. 14:15–16:30
    🎨 Biennale Arte 2026, Giardini Info ↗Country pavilions dotted around a park. Tickets online: €30 adult, €16 Aimee (bring ID).
  7. 16:30
    🌅 Walk to Sant’Elena for the sunsetSunset 17:01.
  8. 17:10
    🚤 Line 4.1, Sant’Elena → Fondamente Nove (17:34)Freshen up at the flat.
  9. 20:45
    🧳 Leave dinner, collect the bags
  10. 21:32
    🛥 Alilaguna Blue line to the airportFrom Fondamente Nove “A”, arrives 22:10. Not covered by the boat passes.
  11. 22:40
    🚌 Bus 5 to Tessera (22:42)Short hop to the guest house for a few hours’ sleep.

Home

  1. 04:53

🎟 Boat passes

  • Thu–Fri, adults: ACTV 2-day pass, €35 each. First tap Thursday morning.
  • Aimee: Rolling Venice card + 72-hour pass, €33 (buy online, ages 6–29).
  • Tue & Wed: tap a contactless card, €9.50 per ride. One card can tap for all three.
  • The Alilaguna airport boat is not included in the passes.
  • Check ACTV service notices the day before (fog or high water).
